title: Genomics & Bioinformatics Laboratory
objective: Complete genomics and bioinformatics analysis workflow from sample reception to data submission
content: Genomics & Bioinformatics Laboratory notebook template with 10 predefined workflow pages for sample reception, DNA/RNA extraction, quality assessment, PCR amplification, gel electrophoresis, library preparation, bioanalyzer QC, sequencing, bioinformatics analysis, and storage.

pages.title: Sample Reception & Registration
pages.instructions: Register sample receipt: Assign or retain Sample ID, capture organism/tissue type, note sample source and collection date, record requested analysis type, document storage conditions at arrival, receipt date/time, and receiving personnel. Link to research project or study if applicable.
pages.content: Sample Reception & Registration - Batch verification and metadata capture of incoming biological samples

manifestColumns.label: Sample ID
manifestColumns.description: Unique identifier assigned to the genomic sample at collection or submission.

manifestColumns.label: Sample Type
manifestColumns.description: Biological material type submitted for genomic analysis (e.g., DNA, RNA, tissue, isolate, PCR product, library, swab).

manifestColumns.label: Collection Date
manifestColumns.description: Date the sample was collected from the organism or environment.

manifestColumns.label: Source
manifestColumns.description: Origin of the sample — patient, animal, environmental isolate, or cell culture.

manifestColumns.label: Reception Date & Time
manifestColumns.description: Date and time the sample was formally received at the genomics laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Project/Study
manifestColumns.description: Research project or study protocol this sample is linked to.

manifestColumns.label: Volume/Concentration
manifestColumns.description: Initial volume (µL) or concentration (ng/µL) of the sample as submitted.

manifestColumns.label: A260/280
manifestColumns.description: DNA purity ratio measured by NanoDrop; ideal range 1.8–2.0 for pure DNA.

manifestColumns.label: A260/230
manifestColumns.description: Secondary purity metric indicating contamination by salts, phenol, or carbohydrates; ideal >2.0.

manifestColumns.label: RIN
manifestColumns.description: RNA Integrity Number scored 0–10; values ≥7 indicate acceptable RNA quality for sequencing.

manifestColumns.label: Extraction Method/Kit
manifestColumns.description: Nucleic acid extraction method or commercial kit used (e.g., TRIzol, RNeasy Mini Kit, CTAB, Phenol-Chloroform).

manifestColumns.label: PCR Protocol
manifestColumns.description: PCR amplification protocol applied to this sample (e.g., Standard PCR, RT-PCR, qRT-PCR, Nested PCR).

manifestColumns.label: Library Prep Protocol
manifestColumns.description: Sequencing library preparation kit or protocol used (e.g., NEBNext Ultra II, TruSeq DNA, Nextera XT).
manifestColumns.example: NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit

manifestColumns.label: Sequencing Platform
manifestColumns.description: Sequencing instrument platform used for this sample (e.g., Illumina MiSeq, Illumina NextSeq, PacBio).

manifestColumns.label: Run ID
manifestColumns.description: Unique identifier of the sequencing run in which this sample was processed.

manifestColumns.label: Operator
manifestColumns.description: Name or ID of the laboratory technician who performed the extraction or sequencing.

manifestColumns.label: Processing Date & Time
manifestColumns.description: Date and time the sample was processed (extracted, amplified, or sequenced).

manifestColumns.label: Notes
manifestColumns.description: Additional remarks about the sample quality, handling, or special processing requirements.
manifestColumns.example: Low input DNA; used low-input protocol

pages.title: DNA/RNA Extraction
pages.instructions: Document extraction protocol used. Record extraction date/time and technician ID. Select extraction kit/method from dropdown. Document sample quantity and condition. Record extraction yield (ng/uL) and purity (A260/A280 ratio). Document any deviations or observations. Store extracted material location and conditions.
pages.content: DNA/RNA Extraction - Nucleic acid isolation and documentation

pages.title: Quality & Quantity Assessment
pages.instructions: Record QC assessment date/time. Select QC instrument (NanoDrop, Qubit, BioAnalyzer). Document quantity (ng or ug) and purity metrics (A260/A280, A260/A230). Record fragment size if assessed (bp). Document QC status (Pass/Fail) with acceptance criteria. If failed, document reason and recommended action. Capture QC instrument ID and calibration status.
pages.content: Quality & Quantity Assessment - QC validation with auto-pass/fail determination

pages.title: PCR Amplification
pages.instructions: Record PCR date/time and technician ID. Select PCR target gene/region and primer set. Select thermal cycler instrument ID. Document PCR master mix composition and volume. Record cycling conditions (annealing temp, cycles, extension time). Document primer final concentrations. Record PCR product yield and estimate. Document any complications or optimization notes. Store PCR product conditions.
pages.content: PCR Amplification - Target region amplification and documentation

pages.title: Gel Electrophoresis
pages.instructions: Record gel date/time and technician ID. Select gel type (agarose %, TAE buffer). Document sample loading (uL volume, dye used). Select electrophoresis apparatus ID and run conditions (voltage, duration). Record molecular weight marker used. Upload gel image file. Document band presence/absence and estimated size (bp). Document any anomalies or failed bands.
pages.content: Gel Electrophoresis - PCR product verification and sizing

pages.title: Library Preparation
pages.instructions: Record library prep date/time and technician ID. Select library prep kit/protocol. Document DNA input amount (ng). Record barcodes/adapters used for each sample. Document shearing parameters (if applicable). Select library prep instrument ID. Record final library concentration and volume. Document size distribution (bp). Select target insert size. Document any deviations.
pages.content: Library Preparation - Sequencing library construction and QC

pages.title: Bioanalyzer QC
pages.instructions: Record Bioanalyzer run date/time and technician ID. Select Bioanalyzer chip type (DNA, RNA). Load samples in specified microfluidic lanes. Verify ladder run passes. Record library concentration (ng/uL). Document size distribution profile. Record DIN (DNA Integrity Number) if RNA. Document QC status (Pass/Fail) with acceptance criteria. If failed, document reason and next steps. Upload Bioanalyzer file output.
pages.content: Bioanalyzer QC - Library quality and fragment size distribution analysis

pages.title: Sequencing
pages.instructions: Record sequencing date/time and technician ID. Select sequencing platform (Illumina, PacBio, Nanopore). Document run parameters (read type, flow cell, reagent kit). Record loading concentration (pM). Select data output location and storage backup. Document run start/completion times. Monitor cluster density and phasing metrics. Record raw data file paths and naming convention. Document any run errors or quality issues.
pages.content: Sequencing - Raw sequencing data generation and initial QC

pages.title: Bioinformatics Analysis & Data Submission
pages.instructions: Record analysis start date/time and bioinformatician ID. Select analysis pipeline (genome assembly, variant calling, etc.). Document reference genome version and parameters. Record read mapping/alignment statistics. Document variant calls, copy numbers, or other analysis results. Perform secondary analysis review and validation. Select data submission repository (NCBI, ENA, etc.). Record submission accession numbers. Document data archival locations and retention periods. Generate analysis summary report.
pages.content: Bioinformatics Analysis & Data Submission - Data processing, analysis, and public repository submission

pages.title: Storage & Environmental Monitoring
pages.instructions: Assign samples to hierarchical storage locations. Select appropriate condition: DNA at -20°C/-80°C, RNA at -80°C, PCR products at -20°C.
pages.content: Storage & Environmental Monitoring - Physical storage management, temperature monitoring, and sample lifecycle tracking
